flags.description: Adfinity Media Q3 spend of R118,000 is approximately 22% over the budgeted R96,500. Marketing lead should be notified.
Office Supplies Co original invoice contained a duplicate line item. Corrected invoice reissued at R3,240 (was R4,100). Resolved, no further action needed.
Possible duplicate of transaction 8451f20f-e493-46d1-9346-df3891606305 (same vendor, amount, and date).
Two identical Adobe subscription charges of R899 appear on the same date (Aug 14).
Consulting retainer of R485,000.00 via wire transfer is drastically larger than all other entries in this log, which range from R60 to R210. This warrants review and approval verification.
Petty cash reconciliation for September is incomplete — only 60% of receipts submitted. Deadline is end of week.
Flight cost of $340 USD and conference registration of €150 EUR require currency conversion to ZAR before total claim can be finalised. Submitter has explicitly requested conversion guidance.
Email references a potentially overdue invoice from vendor 'Meridian' but provides no invoice ID, amount, date, or other details to identify or confirm the specific invoice.
Approver has indicated only one item can be processed today — prioritisation decision is pending. Both items have a Friday deadline and neither has been approved yet.
Unclear whether the R12,900 paid in July was a partial payment or if there is a discrepancy against the supplier's stated invoice amount of R14,200. A R1,300 difference remains unresolved.
Expense claim spans three currencies (ZAR, USD, EUR). A consistent base currency (ZAR) and applicable exchange rates must be confirmed by Finance before reimbursement can be processed.
Vendor contract renewal for Zenith IT Services requires sign-off by Friday or it lapses automatically, risking loss of current rate of R28,000/month.
Q3 travel expense batch (11 claims, R19,400) must be approved before Friday 5pm payroll cutoff or reimbursement rolls to next cycle, delaying staff payments by one month.
Kaelo Print Solutions is threatening to pause the next print run if the payment discrepancy is not resolved this week. Urgent resolution required.
CloudHost Ltd invoice INV-88213 for R42,500 is 12 days overdue. Sign-off required to release payment or a hold reason must be documented.
